# Organisms
Humanity is not alone among the stars, and little of what it has found is friendly. The existence of most of these creatures are not known to the common man.
- [textlink="Yautja" link="CMUGuideLoreHunters"]: the ancient warrior species that stalks the galaxy for sport. - [textlink="Xenomorphs" link="CMUGuideLoreAliens"]: acid-blooded parasites. - [textlink="Pathogen" link="CMUGuideLorePathogen"]: an unknown fungal infestation. - [textlink="Biomorphs" link="CMUGuideLoreBiomorphs"]: twisted flesh that wears the faces of its victims. - [textlink="Apes" link="CMUGuideLoreApes"]: hungry, powerful megafauna of the frontier wilds. - [textlink="Tribals" link="CMUGuideLoreTribals"]: a stone-age people who defend their homeworlds from invaders.
